answer: Your ID needs to be verified for check-in. The host will send you a personal 6-digit door code after your ID is verified. Please ensure your ID is ready for upload at least 24 hours before your arrival.
guest_message: Is my ID verified for check-in?
evidence:
[{"source_id":"3.5","title":"Self check-in","text":"House manual > 3. Getting Here and Arriving > 3.5 Self check-in

Check-in time is **2:00 PM**. The apartments use a smart keypad lock, so no one has to meet you.

1. Arrive at Gate 2 and tell the guard your apartment number. The guard will register you.
2. Take the lift to your floor.
3. On the day of arrival, once your ID is verified (and, for direct bookings, your balance is paid), the host messages you a personal 6-digit door code.
4. Touch the keypad to wake it, enter the code, then press the **#** key.

Your code works from 2:00 PM on the arrival day until 11:00 AM on the departure day. The front desk can help in person between 9:00 AM and 9:00 PM. Door codes are only ever sent by the host to the person on the booking. Nobody else, including the front desk and guards, will tell a code to anyone who asks."},{"source_id":"3.4","title":"Guest registration and ID","text":"House manual > 3. Getting Here and Arriving > 3.4 Guest registration and ID

Pakistani law and our building rules require us to register every adult guest. Before arrival, every guest aged 18 or over must send:

- **Pakistani nationals:** a clear photo of the CNIC (front and back).
- **Foreign nationals:** a photo of the passport photo page and the visa page.

The host sends an upload link when you book. Please complete it **at least 24 hours before arrival**. The primary guest on the booking must be 21 or older. **Your door code is only released after your ID has been verified** (section 3.5)."},{"source_id":"3.7","title":"Late arrival","text":"House manual > 3. Getting Here and Arriving > 3.7 Late arrival

Self check-in works at any hour. If you will arrive after **11:00 PM**, tell the host in advance so the guard expects you. The guards at Gate 2 are on duty all night, but the front desk is closed after 9:00 PM."},{"source_id":"20.5","title":"First-time visitors to Pakistan","text":"House manual > 20. Tips for Different Kinds of Guests > 20.5 First-time visitors to Pakistan

- Keep a photo of your passport (or CNIC) on your phone. You will need it at check-in registration (section 3.4).
- Dress modestly in the lobby and corridors (section 11.9).
- Many shops close briefly around midday on Fridays for Friday prayers, and food delivery can be slower in the evening.
- For sightseeing, food, transport and local costs around Lahore, use the separate local guide; this manual only covers the building and your apartment."}]
